summary: Enhance your compliance skills with our comprehensive AML and CTF Regulations Course. Learn essential strategies to combat financial crime effectively.
lede: Anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing (CTF) training helps professionals assess risk and review customer and transaction activity. Designed for compliance officers, financial-crime analysts, KYC and screening specialists, and operational managers, it builds practical skills in customer due diligence, alert triage, screening-match review, red-flag classification, and documenting and escalating suspicious activity using a risk-based approach.
audienceIntro: This AML and CTF regulations course is built for professionals who need to apply the risk-based approach in real operational settings, review customer and transaction activity, and document decisions that stand up to scrutiny.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of compliance principles and basic exposure to customer onboarding, transaction review, or internal controls. Prior experience in AML, KYC, investigations, sanctions screening, or risk management is helpful, but not mandatory. No coding or programming is required. The course is positioned at intermediate to advanced level and covers AML and CTF at operational and applied implementation depth, not at legal advisory depth.
